name: Tara Iti Golf Club
description: A Tom Doak masterpiece ranked number one in New Zealand and consistently placed inside the world's top 20. This invitation-only links course threads through pristine coastal dunes north of Auckland, delivering a raw, strategic test of golf in an untouched landscape.

name: Te Arai Links South
description: Designed by the acclaimed duo of Coore and Crenshaw, this coastal links sits between native forest and the Tasman Sea. Ranked second in New Zealand, the course flows through dramatic duneland with wide strategic corridors and firm, fast playing surfaces.

name: Te Arai Links North
description: Tom Doak's North course at Te Arai weaves through a striking corridor of coastal forest and open duneland. The layout journeys from the coast into the trees and back again, offering a quieter, more contemplative companion to its celebrated neighbour.

name: Kauri Cliffs Golf Course
description: A World Top 100 clifftop course designed by David Harman, with 15 of its 18 holes offering sweeping views over the Pacific Ocean. Set on a luxury lodge estate in the Bay of Islands, Kauri Cliffs combines breathtaking scenery with championship-calibre golf.

name: Carrington Golf Club
description: A scenic resort course perched on the Karikari Peninsula in the Far North, featuring panoramic ocean views and the longest par 5 in New Zealand at 569 metres. The dramatic coastal setting and warm subtropical climate make it a memorable round year-round.

name: Whangarei Golf & Country Club
description: The premier club in Northland's largest city, offering a well-maintained parkland layout that suits golfers of all abilities. Mature trees and tidy presentation make this a reliable choice when visiting the Whangarei area.

name: Bay of Islands Golf Club
description: A friendly parkland course in the heart of the Bay of Islands, one of New Zealand's most popular holiday destinations. Its relaxed atmosphere and pleasant layout make it a great addition to any Northland golf trip.

name: Mangawhai Golf Club
description: A popular, visitor-friendly course near the surf and sand of Mangawhai Heads. The well-kept layout offers an enjoyable round in a laid-back coastal setting just 90 minutes north of Auckland.

name: Houhora Golf Club
description: New Zealand's most northerly golf course, situated on State Highway 1 between Kaitaia and Cape Reinga. This welcoming 9-hole layout (playable as 18 with alternate tees) is surrounded by lush greenery and coastal scenery, making it a bucket-list stop for golfing travellers.

name: Ngunguru Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole course nestled in the Ngunguru Sports Complex on the beautiful Tutukaka Coast. The stunning coastal backdrop and relaxed pace make it a delightful detour for golfers visiting Northland.

name: Broadwood Golf Club
description: A compact 9-hole course tucked into the rolling countryside of the Far North. Set amid beautiful Northland farmland, Broadwood offers a quiet, unhurried round well off the beaten track.

name: Kaitaia Golf Club
description: Known as the 90 Mile Beach Links, this course is situated at Ahipara, just 15 minutes west of Kaitaia. The coastal setting at the southern end of Ninety Mile Beach gives it a character unlike any other course in the Far North.

name: Northern Wairoa Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course perched beside the Tasman Sea at Baylys Beach, just north of Dargaville. Wide fairways, pohutukawa-lined holes, true greens, and notably no bunkers create a distinctive seaside experience with panoramic ocean views.

name: Okaihau Golf Club
description: A scenic 9-hole course with dual tees, established in 1928, sitting halfway between Kerikeri and Kaikohe at an elevation of 200 metres. Near Lake Omapere, the course offers views stretching to the Bay of Islands and a famously warm welcome from local members.

name: Tapora Golf Club
description: Established in 1964 on the undulating sand dunes of the Kaipara Harbour, this 9-hole links course was the first in New Zealand to install synthetic greens. Elevated holes in the middle of the course offer magnificent harbour views, while surrounding farmland and avocado orchards complete the scene.

name: The Pines Golf Club
description: A picturesque course with stunning views of the harbour and Whangarei Heads from many tee, fairway, and green locations. The elevated vantage points and coastal panoramas make this one of the most scenic rounds in the Northland region.

name: Waipu Golf Club
description: A lovely parkland course in the Scottish heritage town of Waipu, about an hour north of Auckland. The well-maintained layout and friendly club atmosphere reflect the town's proud community spirit.

name: Hikurangi Golf Club
description: An inviting 18-hole course set amid the rolling hills of Northland, just north of Whangarei. Picturesque views and well-kept fairways make Hikurangi a pleasant stop for golfers exploring the region.

name: Rawene Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole course overlooking the Hokianga Harbour in the historic town of Rawene. The layout starts flat before climbing to reveal harbour views, and the summer-only season adds to its remote, unspoiled appeal.

name: Sherwood Park Golf Club
description: Situated just 7 km from Whangarei, this picturesque course is set among beautiful groves of native trees complemented by natural stone walls and native birdlife. The secluded setting provides an ideal atmosphere for a relaxing yet challenging round, and visitors can be sure of a warm welcome.

name: Waiotira Golf Club
description: A welcoming 9-hole course established in 1947 in the scenic Northland countryside near Whangarei. Originally named "Kieowai" Golf Club, its history reflects the union of the Waikiekie and Waiotira districts, and its affordable, community-focused spirit endures today.

name: Wellsford Golf and Squash Club Inc.
description: Less than an hour north of Auckland Harbour Bridge on State Highway 1, this course offers a friendly country atmosphere with a competitive and challenging layout suitable for all ages.

name: Whangaroa Golf Club
description: An 18-hole course on State Highway 10 in the Far North, with mown fairways flanked by mature trees and small, well-kept greens. The course rating sits more than three shots under its par of 70, rewarding accurate play in a peaceful Northland setting.

name: Northland Golf Club
description: A beautiful course set in the valley between Mt Hurupaki and Mt Parakiori in the Northland region. The twin volcanic backdrops and mature native plantings give this layout a sense of place that is hard to match.

name: Paparoa Golf Club
description: A true rural golfing experience in a lovely valley in the Kaipara District, just 20 minutes off State Highway 1. The 9-hole layout features well-protected greens and is split down the middle by a quiet country road, adding quirky charm to every round.

name: Waitangi Golf Club
description: A casual and welcoming club near the historic Waitangi Treaty Grounds in the Bay of Islands. Its relaxed vibe and storied surroundings make it a fitting choice for golfers soaking in the cultural and natural beauty of the region.

name: 90 Mile Beach Golf Links
description: A quirky 9-hole links at the southern end of iconic Ninety Mile Beach, where sheep share the fairways and the Tasman Sea provides the backdrop. It is one of the most unusual and memorable golfing experiences in New Zealand.

name: Kaikohe Golf Club
description: An affordable rural parkland course in the Far North town of Kaikohe. Its easygoing atmosphere and gentle terrain make it a pleasant option for a casual round while exploring the mid-North.

name: Dargaville Golf Club
description: A classic rural club in the kauri country of Northland, close to Dargaville and the Waipoua Forest. The unpretentious layout and friendly locals offer a genuine taste of small-town New Zealand golf.

name: Parahaki Golf Club
description: A compact 9-hole course on the slopes of Parahaki hill in Whangarei. Very affordable and perfect for a quick round, it provides pleasant views across the city and surrounding hills.
